faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI menu images.

items.question: How do I generate a food photo?
items.answer: Open any menu item in your dashboard, tap 'Generate Image', and AI creates a professional food photo based on the dish name and description. Pick the one you like.

items.question: Can I use my own photos instead?
items.answer: Absolutely. Upload your own photos from your phone or computer. AI generation is optional — use it when you don't have a photo ready.

items.question: How many images can I generate?
items.answer: Image generation limits depend on your plan. Basic includes a monthly allowance, and Pro offers a higher limit. You can always upload your own photos without limits.

items.question: Are generated images unique to my restaurant?
items.answer: Yes. Each image is generated uniquely for your specific dish. No stock photos — every image is created fresh based on your menu item.
